description: Bounded projection of the six equal native random_owned_controlled_state candidate draws before the typed construction-legality trigger. The outer random_owned_controlled_state scope supplies ownership/control; the baseline helper excludes only an existing special facility. engine_can_construct is declared but intentionally ignored before the owner patch. Naval coastal eligibility is explicitly retained in both phases. Each supplied coastal_allowed flag is the explicit existing naval coast predicate, true for nonnaval requests; no native legality is inferred.

candidates.eligibleWhen: state.alpha_owned == true and state.alpha_controlled == true and state.alpha_special_facility_level < 1 and state.alpha_coastal_allowed == true
state.bravo_owned == true and state.bravo_controlled == true and state.bravo_special_facility_level < 1 and state.bravo_coastal_allowed == true
state.charlie_owned == true and state.charlie_controlled == true and state.charlie_special_facility_level < 1 and state.charlie_coastal_allowed == true
state.delta_owned == true and state.delta_controlled == true and state.delta_special_facility_level < 1 and state.delta_coastal_allowed == true
state.echo_owned == true and state.echo_controlled == true and state.echo_special_facility_level < 1 and state.echo_coastal_allowed == true
state.foxtrot_owned == true and state.foxtrot_controlled == true and state.foxtrot_special_facility_level < 1 and state.foxtrot_coastal_allowed == true
